name: Arvis
summary: Arvis features an Italian white ceramic top that brings a sleek, refined surface with a cool, contemporary elegance. The body is finished in brass metallic paint, giving it a warm, luminous presence that stands out immediately. Inside, melamine panels keep the structure crisp and polished, while the fabric-lined drawer adds a soft, tailored note. The result is a piece that feels intentionally upscale without shouting about it. Top with 5mm Italy white ceramic, the body paint in brass metallic inner panels with melamine. drawer inside with fabric 48×51
